description: Lifecycle-level benchmark (ADR-0048): a physical PROBLEM in -> a coherent, honestly-labelled InventionPackage out. Scored by forge_mind.invention.rubric.score_lifecycle. Producing outputs needs Fable (the front door); the scoring is deterministic. Frozen: edit = a new version, not an in-place change.

problems.problem: Cables keep falling off my desk edge. I need a 3D-printable way to route two USB-C cables along the front edge of my desk without screwing anything into the desk or leaving adhesive residue.
I want a 3D-printable stand that holds my phone at a comfortable viewing angle on my desk and works in both portrait and landscape, with no hardware.
I need somewhere to hang my headphones at my desk. A printable hook that clamps onto the underside of a desktop without tools or screws and does not mark the surface.

My desktop FDM 3D printer sits on a normal desk and shakes the whole desk during fast moves. Reduce the vibration transferred into the desk without making the printer unstable or permanently mounting it.
